_doc: [v6yard] Look of the yard machines (systems/camp/machine_art.gd) and their round picture signs. Colours are #rrggbb. signs.defaults applies to every sign; a machine's own entry overrides it. icon: wrench | bin | bale | belt | leaf | signal | bot. size: metres across. show: false removes the sign. post_height: height of the sign's centre where it stands on a post. baler / belt: the machines' paint. pod: the repair cart that stands by the crashed pod once the first upgrade is bought (service: false removes it). See docs/ADJUSTING.md, 'Yard machines and landmarks'.
